steps.name: branch name
steps.why: Conventional Branch: <type>/<description>. In CI it reads the PR's head branch, so --no-verify does not get past it. Bot branches pass.

steps.name: format
steps.why: lint-staged formats what a commit touches. A file written by a script or an agent that bypassed the hook shows up here.

steps.name: bundles
steps.why: Every bundle config must resolve: unknown skill, missing rule script, include cycle.

steps.name: agents lock
steps.why: Every dir in .agents/skills has a pin and every pin a dir. A dead pin resurfaces on the next sync.

steps.name: audit
steps.why: High and critical advisories only. Lower levels fire on transitive dev dependencies and train everyone to ignore the check.
